    if(!visited[v])

        visited[v] = true;
        explore(visited, (v*base)%modVal, base, modVal);
    }
}

{
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 1)

        result = p;

            explore(isVisited, i, k, p);
            result = (result * p) % MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << result << endl;
    return 0;
}
